name: Money and Elections: Aggregate Comparison Lab
purpose: Neutral public education on campaign finance, election-administration costs, counted ballots, data comparability and the secret ballot.
lead: Money in elections is measurable. A ballot is not a commodity.

source_rules.name: Federal campaign finance statistics
source_rules.meaning: Aggregate money reported by committee types and periods; different categories not freely addable

source_rules.name: Federal reporting method
source_rules.meaning: Election cycles, disbursements, independent expenditures and reporting scope

source_rules.name: 2024 EAVS and corrected 2026 version
source_rules.meaning: Official election participation and administration data including 2024 V2 release

source_rules.name: EAC ballot privacy
source_rules.meaning: Voting history is not individual's marked ballot

source_rules.name: International IDEA global political finance
source_rules.meaning: Country regulations and oversight, not globally comparable individual vote purchase price

source_rules.name: Federal prohibited voting payments
source_rules.meaning: Relevant federal law, not a calculation on campaign spending

inputs.denominator: counted ballots from matched aggregate, minimum 1000 in this educational harness
inputs.sources: two HTTPS references for each region in non-fictional mode

output.comparability: Matched scope, cycle, coverage, jurisdiction, exclusions for internal transfers, current publications required before interpretation

cross_country.scope: Comparative political-finance regulations and reporting systems rather than invented scalar election integrity ratings
requires: political finance legislation and enforcement evidence
exchange-rate or purchasing-power normalization when appropriate

prohibited: vote price inferred from campaign spend
fraud labels inferred from spending metrics
official elections claims without source validation
agency: Equal public access; no hidden location, visitor ID or differential political content. User selects what public aggregate figures to examine and chooses whether to copy.

fast_evolution.principle: Faster independently validated learning, not more repetitions
success_indicators: faster access to correct official source
fast_evolution.cross_agent_rule: Model opinions do not establish observer independence; trace original evidence lineage before counting corroboration.

provenance.creator: CoCivium experimental public research
provenance.freshness: Source references reviewed Oct 24 2026; update or expire assumptions as records change
